story_note: Isla visits a bookshop cafe corner on Thursday, encountering a puzzle that resists early progress, requiring a methodical rebuild of strategy.
continuation_note: Unlike the past two days of thoughtful pauses at the window desk, today Isla faces a more stubborn early blockage in a new setting, forcing a complete reset before finding her rhythm.
facebook_post_text: Thursday morning at the bookshop corner, and the puzzle wasn't giving anything away easily. Sometimes you have to start over to see it right. https://suite.sapiverpress.co.uk
